title: Add an option to "always show icon only" for tasks, but continue to show others icon + text.
line: In the Icons-and-Text Task Manager, any program can now be set to show only its icon from its right-click More menu.
explanation: The Icons-and-Text Task Manager showed every task with its label, and only pinned launchers were drawn as plain icons, so there was no way to keep a few easy-to-recognize programs compact while others kept their titles. The change adds a per-widget list of app ids (iconOnlyAppIds) and a "Show only the icon for this program" checkbox under More in the task context menu; tasks of those programs are laid out like launchers (icon-sized, no label), while the group popup still shows titles.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: allow showing only the icon for chosen programs

The Icons-and-Text Task Manager always showed a label for every task, so
programs that are easy to recognize by their icon took as much space as
the rest. Add a checkbox to the More menu that makes a program icon-only.

BUG: 391572

patches.diff:
From 9114e4d77f311c3d80ba40d950c11fd7474c37c6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 20:11:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: allow showing only the icon for chosen
 programs

The Icons-and-Text Task Manager always showed a label for every task, so
programs that are easy to recognize by their icon took as much space as
the rest. Add a checkbox to the More menu that makes a program icon-only.

BUG: 391572
---
 applets/taskmanager/main.xml            |  4 ++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml | 20 ++++++++++++++++++++
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml        |  6 +++---
 3 files changed, 27 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
index 8c3b68785b..4f670d8817 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/main.xml
@@ -50,6 +50,10 @@
       <label>The launcher URLs (usually .desktop file or executable URLs) of applications that should not have their tasks grouped.</label>
       <default></default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="iconOnlyAppIds" type="StringList">
+      <label>The id's (usually .desktop file names) of applications whose tasks show only their icon, without a label.</label>
+      <default></default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="sortingStrategy" type="Int">
       <label>Values from TaskManager::TasksModel::SortMode</label>
       <default>1</default>
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml
index fe837049fc..30593dcd77 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml
@@ -817,6 +817,26 @@ PlasmaExtras.Menu {
 
                 onClicked: tasksModel.requestToggleGrouping(menu.modelIndex)
             }
+
+            PlasmaExtras.MenuItem {
+                visible: !tasks.iconsOnly && menu.visualParent && menu.get(TaskManager.AbstractTasksModel.IsWindow)
+                    && menu.get(TaskManager.AbstractTasksModel.AppId) !== ""
+
+                checkable: true
+                checked: menu.visualParent && Plasmoid.configuration.iconOnlyAppIds.includes(menu.get(TaskManager.AbstractTasksModel.AppId))
+
+                text: i18nc("@option:check inmenu", "Show only the icon for this program")
+                icon: "view-list-icons"
+
+                onClicked: {
+                    const appId = menu.get(TaskManager.AbstractTasksModel.AppId);
+                    const appIds = Plasmoid.configuration.iconOnlyAppIds.filter(id => id !== appId);
+                    if (appIds.length === Plasmoid.configuration.iconOnlyAppIds.length) {
+                        appIds.push(appId);
+                    }
+                    Plasmoid.configuration.iconOnlyAppIds = appIds;
+                }
+            }
         }
     }
 
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..f615c0d4c4 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -44,7 +44,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
     Layout.fillHeight: !inPopup
     Layout.maximumWidth: tasksRoot.vertical
         ? -1
-        : ((model.IsLauncher && !tasksRoot.iconsOnly) ? tasksRoot.height / taskList.rows : TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMaxWidth())
+        : ((isIcon && !tasksRoot.iconsOnly) ? tasksRoot.height / taskList.rows : TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMaxWidth())
     Layout.maximumHeight: tasksRoot.vertical ? TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMaxHeight() : -1
 
     required property var model
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
     readonly property int pid: model.AppPid
     readonly property string appName: model.AppName
     readonly property string appId: model.AppId
-    readonly property bool isIcon: tasksRoot.iconsOnly || model.IsLauncher
+    readonly property bool isIcon: tasksRoot.iconsOnly || model.IsLauncher || Plasmoid.configuration.iconOnlyAppIds.includes(model.AppId)
     property bool toolTipOpen: false
     property bool inPopup: false
     property bool isWindow: model.IsWindow
@@ -614,7 +614,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
     PlasmaComponents3.Label {
         id: label
 
-        visible: (task.inPopup || !task.tasksRoot.iconsOnly && !task.model.IsLauncher
+        visible: (task.inPopup || !task.isIcon
             && (parent.width - iconBox.height - Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing) >= TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.spaceRequiredToShowText())
 
         anchors {

media.caption: Task context menu, More: no way to make a program icon-only
More now has "Show only the icon for this program" (checked here for Konsole)
Konsole and Dolphin both shown with icon and title
Konsole set to icon-only: its windows are plain icons while Dolphin keeps its title; second row with grouping always on

reviews.text: The UX approach fits the Icons-and-Text Task Manager well by placing a per-program checkbox next to 'Allow this program to be grouped' in the More submenu and persisting iconOnlyAppIds per widget. However, changing Layout.maximumWidth in Task.qml from model.IsLauncher to isIcon breaks the GroupDialog popup for grouped icon-only apps, because isIcon stays true when inPopup is true and clamps group popup rows to tasksRoot.height / taskList.rows width, crushing their titles. Additionally, ContextMenu.qml checks AppId !== "" which evaluates to true if the model role returns undefined or null.
changes: In applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml, exclude inPopup from isIcon (or from the icon-sized branch of Layout.maximumWidth), e.g. `readonly property bool isIcon: !inPopup && (tasksRoot.iconsOnly || model.IsLauncher || (Boolean(model.AppId) && Plasmoid.configuration.iconOnlyAppIds.includes(model.AppId)))`, so grouped icon-only tasks keep normal width and readable titles inside GroupDialog.

In applets/taskmanager/qml/ContextMenu.qml, guard AppId with `Boolean(menu.get(TaskManager.AbstractTasksModel.AppId))` instead of `!== ""` so an undefined/null QVariant cannot show the menu item or insert an invalid entry into iconOnlyAppIds.
Verify opening the group popup (GroupDialog) for a grouped icon-only program and confirm window titles render at full width.
